To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
SECRETA is the first system for evaluating and comparing anonymization algorithms that supports both relational and transaction data.

SECRETA is an interactive system that allows data publishers to: • Evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency (i.e., utility) of anonymization algorithms for both relational and transactional datasets.

(1) SECRETA allows data publishers to select the most appropriate anonymization algorithms, for their specific datasets, in a fast and efficient way, and (2) SECRETA provides data publishers with a comprehensive and easy to understand set of results, including attribute distributions and utility indicators, to help them make an informed decision.
In summary, our research is concerned with
providing data publishers with a tool that supports the selection of the most appropriate anonymization algorithm for their datasets.
developing a system for analyzing algorithms that anonymize data, in a way that is easy to understand and use by data publishers.
providing a comprehensive tool that can assist data publishers in selecting the most appropriate anonymization algorithm for their data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SECRETA is a useful and effective tool that assists data publishers in the selection of anonymization algorithms for their datasets.
SECRETA is a useful system for data publishers, who want to select and evaluate anonymization algorithms.
SECRETA provides data publishers with a useful tool for evaluating anonymization algorithms and for selecting the one most appropriate for a given dataset.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SECRETA provides a system to evaluate, compare and combine anonymization algorithms, for datasets with relational and/or transaction attributes, in an interactive way.
we develop a system that allows data publishers to compare anonymization algorithms, in an automated and interactive way, and to select the most appropriate algorithm for their needs.
SECRETA allows data publishers to analyze and compare algorithms for anonymizing their data in a systematic, comprehensive, and interactive way.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SECRETA can be used as a tool for assisting data publishers in the selection of the most appropriate anonymization algorithm(s).
the SECRETA system provides a comprehensive and user-friendly tool that can be used for comparing anonymization algorithms, with respect to their data utility.
SECRETA is the first system to support the analysis of anonymization algorithms for datasets with both relational (e.g., census) and transaction (e.g., credit card) attributes.
